module.title: Kinetic inner-magnetosphere ring-current alternatives CIMI and HEIDI
entrypoints: IM/CIMI standalone: Highordelsr, Prerun, UniformL, WAVES, dipole, drift and flux cases with their variants
test4 (GM-IE-HEIDI), test_swpc_cimi, test_swpc_cimi_species and test_swpc_cimi_pwom_species variants
module.expensive_path: CIMI's bounce-averaged kinetic drift and wave-diffusion solve over the L/MLT/energy/pitch-angle phase-space grid, and HEIDI's drift-loss solve; these are the IM_run expensive paths in coupled sessions.
module.rationale: HEIDI is deliberately folded into CIMI's leaf: it has two standalone cases plus GM-IE-HEIDI (three checks, below the four-check floor), and both codes are kinetic alternatives filling the same IM slot and using the same GM-IM/IE-IM interfaces. RCM2 stays with the coupling leaf because it has no standalone run.
excluded: IM/RCM2 and its operational SWPC coupling (swmf-mit-coupling)
PWOM physics in the CIMI+PWOM species deck; that deck is attributed once to CIMI because CIMI is the graded physics
hazards: HEIDI and inner-magnetosphere outputs are sensitive to optimization; altbuild evidence must be measured on the target host.
The same coupled deck can occur in a CIMI leaf and a coupling leaf only when the graded physics differs; the inventory records that distinction once.
